subject: Help with D3 overlay circles behind leaflet map?

messages.author: 8510f5601600e95e
messages.subject: Help with D3 overlay circles behind leaflet map?
parts:
Hello,

I have a little shiny app to display a leaflet map.  I'm would like to add circles to map using D3.js.  Turns out that the circles are present, but they're behind the map itself -- sometimes during loading I can see the circles than the map shows up on top and covers them up.  Below is the js code, which I've also attached along with the server.R, ui.R and css.

I'm a newbie to shiny and D3, any help would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks in advance.
Glynn

ui.R #########################
library(shiny)
library(jsonlite)


reactiveMap <- function(outputId) 
{
  HTML(paste("<div id=\"", outputId, "\" class=\"shiny-leafletMap-output\"><svg /></div>", sep=""))
}

shinyUI(
  mainPanel(
    includeCSS("leaflet.css"),
    includeHTML("LeafletMap.js"),
    reactiveMap(outputId = "leafletMap")
  )
)
##

server.R ####################
library(shiny)
library(jsonlite)


shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

  leafletMapData <- reactive(function() {  
    p1 <- c(35.3383738,-80.8793378)
    p2 <- c(35.7585758,-80.9595578)
    p3 <- c(35.1787778,-80.7397778)
    p4 <- c(35.9989798,-80.2199978)
  
    x <- rbind(p1,p2,p3,p4)
    colnames(x) <- c('lat','long')
    toJSON(x)
  
  })

  output$leafletMap <- reactive(function() { leafletMapData() })
  
})
##

leafletMap.js ################
<script src="http://d3js.org/d3.v3.min.js"></script>
<script src="http://cdn.leafletjs.com/leaflet-0.7/leaflet.js"></script>
 
<script type="text/javascript">
  var width = 500;
  var height = 500;

var leafletMapOutputBinding = new Shiny.OutputBinding();
$.extend(leafletMapOutputBinding, {
   find: function(scope) {
     return $(scope).find('.shiny-leafletMap-output');
   },
   renderValue: function(el, data) {
        
        pointLocation = JSON.parse(data);
   
//remove old map    
var svg = d3.select("#map").select("svg").remove();
    var map = L.map('leafletMap').setView([35.2284718,-80.8392178], 6);
        
mapLink = '<a href="http://openstreetmap.org">OpenStreetMap</a>';
        
L.tileLayer('http://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
            attribution: '© ' + mapLink + ' Contributors',
            maxZoom: 18,
            })
.addTo(map);  
map._initPathRoot()  
  
 var svg = d3.select("#leafletMap").select("svg"),
 g = svg.append("g");
    svg.attr("width", width).attr("height", height);
    
    pointLocation.forEach(function(d) {
      d.LatLng = new L.LatLng(d[0], d[1])
    });
    
var feature = g.selectAll("circle")
      .data(pointLocation)
.enter().append("circle")
.style("stroke", "black")  
.style("opacity", .6) 
.style("fill", "red")
.attr("r", 5);  


    map.on("viewreset", update);
update();
 
function update() {
feature.attr("transform", 
function(d) { 
return "translate("+ 
map.latLngToLayerPoint(d.LatLng).x +","+ 
map.latLngToLayerPoint(d.LatLng).y +")";

}
)
}
}
});
Shiny.outputBindings.register(leafletMapOutputBinding, 'patronlink.leafletMapOutputBinding');  
</script>
##
